drProtectionBody: Steam may keep received items under trade protection for up to {days} days, during which they cannot be traded or sold. Accounts without the Steam Guard Mobile Authenticator can face a trade hold of up to {hold} days.
drGuaranteeBody: If we cannot deliver the item within {hours} hours, or Steam reverses the trade during trade protection, we refund the price you paid for it within {refundDays} days.
drWithdrawalBody: You have a {days}-day right to cancel until delivery begins. Checkout is where you instruct us to begin delivery at once, and that instruction spends the right.
